summary: Operator's own WooCommerce booking read in the browser: every site $40/night (10% off 7 nights), $700/month for contract workers by phone, 30 sites (15 back-in/15 pull-through, 50/20A FHU, 70 ft+). Occupancy: only sites 11-15 open nightly Nov 2026-Jan 2027; the other 14 online sites blocked every night. Passes the long-stay tests narrowly; note says mostly monthly.
flags: Price gate: $40/night on the operator's own booking site (every site, read 2026-11-08). No gateway within 40 km (Kansas City 74 km) - not needed. Presence: own website with phone (816) 876-0080 + booking; Google 4.9 over 34 reviews (the search opened a results list; the first result is this park, starlitemo.com); RV Life 4.5* over 26 (five 9-10/2026 stays at $40, all rated 10).

LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE character (report, I read it as passing): the home page leads its booking box with '$700/month bookings available to contract workers - must call to reserve'. Occupancy check on the booking calendar for every site, Nov 2026-Jan 2027: sites 01-10 and 16-19 are unavailable on all 92 nights; only sites 11-15 are open (11-14 every night, 15 except Nov 20-23), including the two weeknights 2026-11-17/18. RV Life reviewers (10/2026): 'A lot of long term residents here so definitely reserve online or call ahead'; (9/2026) 'There are a few full timers'. Five tests: (1) $40 passes; (2) nightly rate and online booking on its own site, no application - passes; (3) 1-night stays sell - passes; (4) 5 nightly of 30 sites = 1 in 6 - passes; (5) RV park, no homes - passes. The four reviewers on sites 11, 13, 14, 15 were all overnighters.
PHONE missing: the operator gives (816)-876-0080 (apply.py does not write phones). Website works only in a browser - plain HTTP gets 406 from Mod_Security.
sites.max_rig_ft 70 (note-derived) left: the operator says every site is 'at least 70' long', a site length rather than a posted rig limit.
